metas.name: The Simpsons
metas.description: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

metas.name: The Simpsons Movie
metas.description: After Homer accidentally pollutes the town's water supply, Springfield is encased in a gigantic dome by the EPA and the Simpsons are declared fugitives.

metas.name: The Simpsons: Specials & Shorts
metas.description: Every Simpsons short and special outside the regular seasons, from the Maggie shorts to the Disney+ specials.

metas.name: The Simpsons: Holidays
metas.description: Holiday episodes in calendar order. Season 1: Valentine's Day, 2: St. Patrick's Day, 3: Easter, 4: Halloween, 5: Thanksgiving, 6: Christmas.

metas.name: The Simpsons: Treehouse of Horror
metas.description: Every Treehouse of Horror Halloween anthology episode, in order.
